recipe: decider's delta recipe (scripts/train.sh delta: continue a decider checkpoint) with two changes: warmup 150 -> 50 (this run has 466 optimizer steps), none_prob 0.1 -> 0 (the abstain augmentation borrows labels from other clean-label tasks; Mia is the only one here, so it cannot run)
init: Mapika/decider-2b v11, Hub revision 533964da (Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base + decider supervised stages + calibration RL + LoRA stage)

held_domains: a voice call transcript at a call centre

sentiment.instructions: 判断文本作者表达的整体情感倾向。

criteria.负面: 表达不满、失望、批评、愤怒、担忧、厌恶、贬损等态度，反讽按作者实际态度判为负面
criteria.中性: 客观陈述、信息说明、提问、叙述、事实报道，作者态度或情绪不明显；褒贬并存、无法归为一方的也算中性
criteria.正面: 表达满意、赞赏、喜爱、愉快、感谢、期待、推荐等态度

example_question.text: 判断文本作者表达的整体情感倾向。
options: 负面: 表达不满、失望、批评、愤怒、担忧、厌恶、贬损等态度，反讽按作者实际态度判为负面
中性: 客观陈述、信息说明、提问、叙述、事实报道，作者态度或情绪不明显；褒贬并存、无法归为一方的也算中性
正面: 表达满意、赞赏、喜爱、愉快、感谢、期待、推荐等态度

hardware: RTX 4090 48G, bf16, gradient checkpointing, PyTorch fallback kernels for the linear-attention layers
default_scoring_path: questions-first layout with the question prefix cached (decider_config.json schema_first=true)
